backend/main.mo: Main backend actor with product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding/homepage configuration, shop details, Stripe integration, and access control; includes Product type with category field and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old Product and CartItem types (without category) to new types with a default 'Uncategorized' category field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five high-confidence features for adding category field support across BulkProductUpload, ProductManagementTable, Marketplace filtering, and ProductCard components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages, noting that category field has been added to product forms, filters, and display components alongside existing shape field.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with 'Original Creations Hub' title and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup, ThemeProvider, dynamic branding hook, and route definitions for marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment, and legal pages.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, and progress tracking functionality.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, supporting auto-fill from templates, AI description generation, and batch upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing product description templates with name and content fields.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with create, edit, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying shop information, legal links (terms/privacy), contact email, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings form for customizing homepage hero section including motto, promotional text, and hero image upload.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header navigation (logo, basket with count, dashboard, login/logout), content outlet, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that uses the useAddToCart mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product information with options to add to basket or buy now (which navigates to checkout with product ID in sessionStorage).
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for managing products with inline editing of name, description, shape, category, price, and images, plus inventory count adjustment controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that returns null; previously used for post-login profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form for configuring shop details including name, address, contact info (email required), opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key and allowed countries list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Updates document title and favicon dynamically based on branding configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for all backend data operations including products, user profiles, cart management, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, homepage config, and description templates.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for both light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays order summary for cart items or buy-now products, calculates totals, and initiates Stripe checkout sessions with success/cancel URLs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates, showing statistics cards for inventory and product counts.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying featured, most viewed, best selling, and newest products with filtering by shape and category, plus a hero section with configurable background and promotional text.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Displays a payment failure page with an error icon, message, and buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Shows a payment success confirmation page, clears the cart and buyNowProductId from session storage on mount, and provides a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders a static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, cookies, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with product items, quantity controls, remove functionality, and a checkout button with total price calculation.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders a static terms and conditions page covering products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, and liability.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, typography plugin, container queries, animations, and custom font families (Inter and Crimson Pro).
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an Artisan Hub marketplace application with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, Stripe payment processing, and product management features. Contains architectural notes, known issues (image persistence, Buy Now redirect, login prompts), and existing feature definitions with requirement IDs.
